**B. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

This approval is contingent upon the cooperative fulfilling and maintaining the following eligibility criteria:

1. **Registered Cooperative Status**: The cooperative must hold a valid certificate of registration with the Kaduna State Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism, and must be in good standing with the Kaduna State Cooperative Services Agency. A copy of the current registration certificate must be submitted to the Ministry's Input Distribution Unit within fourteen (14) working days of the date of this letter.

2. **Member Farmer Verification**: The cooperative must provide a complete and certified list of its registered member farmers, including their full names, gender, farm location (village, ward, and LGA), farm size (hectares), and National Identification Number (NIN). A summary table of the member list must be forwarded with the certificate of registration. The Ministry reserves the right to conduct physical verification of at least ten percent (10%) of the listed members at any time during the season.

3. **Farm Size Threshold**: Each member farmer must have a minimum of one (1) hectare of cultivable land under their control, either through ownership or long-term lease. The cooperative must provide a declaration signed by each member confirming their farm size and the crops they intend to cultivate during the 2025 wet season.

4. **Crop Focus**: Priority consideration and allocation of the approved quantities are for the cultivation of maize, sorghum, millet, soybean, and rice. The cooperative is expected to ensure that the fertilizer procured under this subsidy is used for these staple crops. Diversion of fertilizer to cash crops such as cotton or groundnut for commercial resale shall constitute a breach of the programme terms.

5. **Payment of Subsidized Contribution**: The cooperative must pay the total subsidized contribution for the approved quantities into the designated Ministry account within twenty-one (21) working days of the date of this letter. We refer to your application dated 17 February 2025 and the subsequent verification visit conducted by the Ministry's Input Distribution Unit on 3 March 2025. The Kaduna State Ministry of Agriculture is pleased to inform you that your application for participation in the 2025 Wet Season Fertilizer Subsidy Programme has been approved under the following terms and conditions.

**A. APPROVED QUANTITIES AND ALLOCATION**

The cooperative is approved for a total allocation of 2,300 (Two Thousand Three Hundred) bags of fertilizer for the 2025 wet season, comprising:

| Fertilizer Type | Quantity (Bags) | Subsidized Price per Bag (NGN) |

This allocation is based on the cooperative's registered membership of 460 active farmers and the total cultivated area of approximately 1,150 hectares declared in your application. The allocation ratio is 5 bags per registered member, subject to the verification of member names against the cooperative's registration records.

**B. CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL**

1. **Purpose Limitation**: The fertilizer supplied under this approval shall be used exclusively for the cultivation of maize, rice, and soybean within the 2025 wet season. Diversion of any quantity to other crops, resale, or any commercial purpose other than the members' own farm use is strictly prohibited.

2. **Collection Schedule**: Fertilizer collection shall be in two tranches. The first tranche (60% of each fertilizer type) shall be available for collection from 7 April 2025. The second tranche (remaining 40%) shall be available from 15 June 2025, subject to submission of a satisfactory first-tranche utilization report. The collection window for each tranche shall close thirty (30) days from the stated availability date.

3. **Quality Verification**: The cooperative is entitled to verify fertilizer quality at the point of collection. Any complaint regarding quality, weight, or packaging must be lodged with the Ministry's Input Distribution Unit within seventy-two (72) hours of collection, failing which the fertilizer shall be deemed to have been received in good condition.

4. **Distribution to Members**: The cooperative shall maintain a transparent distribution register showing each member's name, quantity received, signature, and date of collection. This register shall be made available to Ministry inspectors upon request. The cooperative shall not impose any charge on members beyond the approved subsidized price plus a maximum handling fee of NGN 100 per bag to cover administrative costs.

5. **Payment of Subsidized Contribution**: The cooperative must pay the total subsidized contribution for the approved quantities into the designated Ministry account within twenty-one (21) working days of the date of this letter. The payment schedule is detailed in Section C below. No fertilizer will be released until the full contribution is received and confirmed by the Ministry's Accounts Department.

6. **Offtake Agreement**: The cooperative must execute an offtake agreement with the Ministry, in the format attached hereto, committing to use the fertilizer for the stated purposes and to provide input utilization reports as required.

7. **Monitoring and Inspection**: The Ministry reserves the right to conduct physical inspections of storage facilities, distribution records, and farmlands at any reasonable time during the season. Unannounced inspections may be carried out where the Ministry deems it necessary.
